summary: Round Top Mountain lookout in Dinosaur National Monument, Moffat County, CO: 1951 cabin, mid-1950s wooden tower, 2002 two-story replacement; NPS-staffed summers.

facts.design: Two-story 13-by-13-foot metal lookout of local design with attached living quarters, constructed 2002

access.note: Inside Dinosaur National Monument and staffed in summer; no source says whether visitors may climb it or drive up to it

visit.trail_note: Visible from the Upper Canyon Overlook in Dinosaur National Monument; the overlook page gives no visiting rules, so confirm with the monument before visiting (editor's advice, not from a source)

events.note: Basic 8-by-10-foot plywood cabin built around 1951 and added to in later years
John and Jean Polhamus were the lookouts
Wooden tower with 8-by-8-foot cab added in 1954-57; caption gives 16 feet tall
Steve and Verona Rasmussen staffed the lookout
Modern two-story tower and housing unit installed on the same site, replacing the tower and cabin
Registered January 23, 2010 as US 872, CO 12; nominated by Sondra Kellogg

corrections.proposed: 2002 for the current two-story lookout; earlier cabin c.1951 and wooden tower 1954-57
corrections.why: 1964 appears only in the NHLR Built field. The register's own description, West Lookouts and the 2010 NPS history all date the current two-story structure to 2002.
West Lookouts and the FFLA list spell the county Moffat. The NHLR's Moffatt is the outlier.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's Built field gives 1964, but its description dates the two-story lookout to 2002. Two other sources also give 2002 for the current structure.
NHLR's text gives an 8-foot wooden tower for the mid-1950s structure, but its photo caption and the NPS history give 16 feet tall.
NHLR spells the county Moffatt; West Lookouts and FFLA spell it Moffat.

sources.title: Roundtop Lookout Placed On National Historic Register

notes_for_editor: The 2010 NPS success story is the best history source and agrees with the NHLR description on 1951, the mid-1950s tower and 2002. The NHLR Built field of 1964 is unexplained and should not be used. Current staffing rests on an undated NPS overlook page. Visiting rules were not found; confirm with Dinosaur National Monument before any visit. The 2010 PDF also says the cabin was used until the mid-1950s, which is consistent with the register but not repeated in the story.
